newsitem.title: INDIA: Selection of India satellite dealers ongoing - RBI.
newsitem.headline: Selection of India satellite dealers ongoing - RBI.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Thursday the processing of applications for satellite dealers in government securities was an ongoing process and the applications received so far are in various stages of disposal.
"The applications for satellite dealership are under various stages of disposal," the RBI said in a statement.

"The RBI now clarifies that the receipt of application and approval for both primary dealership and satellite dealership will be an ongoing process and those entities satisfying the eligibilty criteria may apply to the RBI for consideration for primary dealership/satellite dealership, as the case may be," the statement said.

The statement also said that scheduled commercial banks and all-India financial institutions intending to set up subsidiaries for primary dealership/satellite dealership could apply to the RBI furnishing details about the subsidiaries.

"On acceptance in-principle by the RBI, such banks and financial institutions may proceed to set up the subsidiary, which in turn will be allowed to directly apply to the RBI for grant of authorisation," it said.
The RBI had announced the guidelines for satellite dealers in government securities on December 31, 1996 and set the last date for receipt of applications as January 31, 1997.
